name: Multiple Wavefront Recording Planes (WRP) with Horizontal Parallax Only (HPO)
aliases: Fast CGH method for point clouds
definition: A CGH generation technique that uses multiple parallel wavefront recording planes (WRPs) to compute holograms from point clouds. It inherently handles occlusion and is adapted for Horizontal Parallax Only (HPO) displays by computing point contributions to 1D hololines rather than the full 2D plane.
summary: Multiple Wavefront Recording Planes with Horizontal Parallax Only generates computer-generated holograms for point clouds by computing 1D hololines across parallel planes to reduce computational load.
